articles.headline: Google unveils Gemini 3.7 Flash for coding and agent workflows
articles.summary: Google’s new model is aimed at coding and agentic workflows, which could improve automation and software-development productivity for enterprises. Businesses that rely on software teams or AI assistants may see lower development friction and faster deployment cycles.

articles.headline: AI agents’ hacking skills are driving a rush in cybersecurity spending
articles.summary: Security teams are bracing for more capable AI-driven attacks, pushing companies to increase spending on protection tools and services. For businesses, this points to higher security budgets, stronger compliance demands, and more urgency around identity, endpoint, and email defenses.

articles.headline: Optical component shortages are forcing cloud builders to widen their supplier base
articles.summary: Severe shortages of high-speed optical components are reshaping data-center design and forcing cloud operators to rely on more vendors. For businesses, that can mean tighter cloud infrastructure supply, higher costs, and slower expansion of AI and storage capacity.
